        # Compose dict for legacy mirror
        return ConversionJob(
            job_id=str(job.id),
            file_id=job.input_data.get("file_id"),
            original_filename=job.input_data.get("original_filename"),
            status=job.status,
            progress=(progress_val if progress_val is not None else (job.progress.progress if job.progress else 0)),
            target_version=job.input_data.get("target_version"),
            options=job.input_data.get("options"),
            result_url=result_url if result_url is not None else None,
            error_message=error_message,
            created_at=job.created_at,
            updated_at=job.updated_at
        )

        logger.info(f"Job {job_id}: Updating to {status} with progress {progress}%...")
        updated_job = await crud.update_job_status(session, job_id, status)
        await crud.upsert_progress(session, job_id, progress)
        logger.info(f"Job {job_id}: Progress updated to {progress}%, refreshing job from database...")
        updated_job = await crud.get_job(session, job_id)

        if sync_cache:
            logger.info(f"Job {job_id}: Job refreshed, creating mirror...")
            mirror = mirror_dict_from_job(updated_job, progress, result_url, error_message)
            conversion_jobs_db[job_id] = mirror
            logger.info(f"Job {job_id}: Mirror created, updating cache...")
            await cache.set_job_status(job_id, mirror.model_dump())
            await cache.set_progress(job_id, progress)

        logger.info(f"Job {job_id}: Status updated to {updated_job.status}, Progress: {progress}%")
        return updated_job
